audit.why: 55.84% over 874 games. Quinn owns levels 1-3 outright, the middle is genuinely even, and Gangplank takes the lane back on items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Skill at Level 1 and Quinn at both item stages; the packet and the mirror both say Quinn L1, Gangplank at first item and 2+ items.
audit.why: A barrel-less Gangplank cannot contest level 1; by Trinity Force his crit kegs and Remove Scurvy cleansing the Vault slow beat Quinn's lethality spike, and the existing whys[5]/whys[6] already said so.
audit.corrected: Flipped rows 0, 5 and 6 as one atomic group across both layers, with inverse ratings to the mirror (6/10, 3/10, 2/10) and the why text rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Q-blind', 'blind his Parrrley crit' and 'Vault-blind' all claim a blind Quinn does not have; Powder Keg was tracked as a cooldown; wants.foe[0] claimed barrels knock up.
audit.why: Riot's Blinding Assault text says Valor marks an enemy and hinders its vision — a nearsight, not an attack blind. Powder Keg lists cd 0 (charge-stored kegs). Riot's Powder Keg text gives damage spread and a slow, no knockup. Remove Scurvy cures crowd control, so it does clear the Vault slow, on 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Replaced the blind with the nearsight, restated Vault as slow plus brief interrupt, made Powder Keg charge-based, and corrected the barrel effect to a slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing despite Remove Scurvy restoring health.
audit.why: _missing flags needs-antiheal for this matchup — Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Executioner's added to the itemization line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Cannon Barrage ignores resistances.
audit.why: R carries the trueDamage flag — stacking armour or MR is the wrong answer to it.
audit.corrected: Put on the Critical Don'ts line.

edits.before: Passive-mark AA trades win every short exchange. Identify how Gangplank contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Harrier-marked autos out-trade a barrel-less Gangplank at 1 — he can only Parrrley last-hits and a lone keg is slow to arm.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force crit kegs and Remove Scurvy cleansing your Vault slow beat your first lethality item.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Gangplank carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in he out-scales you: crit kegs, true-damage R, 9.5/10 carry threat — close the game before this window opens.

edits.before: All of Q-blind, W-speed and E-reset online means you blind his Parrrley crit and burst him down before chains form.
edits.after: Blinding Assault hinders his vision and Heightened Senses speed pops the keg early, so you burst him before chains form.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Powder Keg stores charges — pop each keg early. Blinding Assault hinders vision; Vault slows and interrupts.

edits.before: Land barrel chains for max knockup zone and W-cleanse your E slow to escape your reset
edits.after: Land barrel chains for the slow zone and cleanse your Vault slow with Remove Scurvy (22s)

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Youmuu's Ghostblade  (roam + burst), then The Collector; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Youmuu's Ghostblade, then The Collector; Executioner's for Remove Scurvy; boots Steelcaps.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage's damage is true — armour and MR will not save you.

notes: Powder Keg's kit entry lists cd 0 because kegs are charge-stored; several inherited strings ('Powder Kegs's cooldown', focus.text, loading) still treat it as a timed cooldown. I corrected the ones inside the length band and left the rest rather than rewrite framing wholesale — flagging for a later pass. Did not assert QSS/tenacity behaviour: Remove Scurvy's cleanse is stated only because Riot's own text says it cures crowd control.
